title: ci: two-speed CI — affected tests on PR and queue runs, full suite and coverage on main's push and hourly schedule, spec gate reuse by objectstack sha, fifteen gate workflows folded into Repo Gates (objectui#12214)
body:
Fixes #12214
Refs objectui#12208 (PR-1)
Clause-②: no

Two-speed CI for objectui under the doctrine of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22998, in four commits plus a `main` merge, so the four diffs read separately. Dispatched on the card's claim; this PR stays a **draft** (a dispatched PR is the seat's to land, and the card asks for an authorised approval before it moves).

| commit | what |
|---|---|
| `6130bef9` | **Tests, two speeds.** `pull_request` / `merge_group` run the affected test files (new `scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`); `push` to `main` and a new hourly `schedule` run the full suite plus the 4-shard coverage lane. |
| `df83ebef` | **objectui#12208 PR-1, folded in by ruling 6121816480 (letter B):** the `Test` matrix goes 8 → 12 legs, every shard-count pin with it. Coverage stays at 4. |
| `58610a4a` | **Spec Main Shape Gate** builds `@objectstack/spec` only when objectstack `main` moved; gains the hourly `schedule` run. |
| `9573c870` | **Repo Gates:** fifteen one-check gate workflows folded into one job, each check kept as named steps. |

## 1. Tests: two speeds (`ci.yml`)

- **Fast set** on `pull_request` and `merge_group`: the workspace packages the change sits in, plus every package depending on them (the set `turbo ls --affected` answers; the new test holds the two equal on a leaf, a mid-graph and a root package), plus an **always-on** set of test files the package graph cannot place: tests outside every package (`scripts/**`, `eslint-rules/**`), tests whose relative-import closure reads the disk or spawns a process, tests that reach a file outside their own package, and tests that import a workspace package their own package does not depend on (the root vitest alias map resolves every `@object-ui/*` name to source, declared or not).
- **Full run** instead when the change reaches something every test runs through: a `package.json`, `vitest.config.*` or `vite.config.*` anywhere (vitest's own `forceRerunTriggers` default), a `tsconfig*.json`, a repository-root non-documentation file or `patches/**`, a file the root vitest config imports, or a package a **broad** setup file imports (the light DOM setup installs the i18n catalogues into every `dom` test). A package only the **heavy** DOM setup imports adds the `dom-heavy` test files (and `apps/console/`, whose config loads that setup) instead of forcing a full run.
- **Fails open:** a selector that exits non-zero, prints no verdict or gets no base sha means the full suite.
- **Full battery:** the matrix, `Test (dist pins)` and the `Test` aggregator lose their push guard; `test-coverage` / `Test (coverage)` run on `push` **and** `schedule`. The aggregator keeps `--shards` equal to the matrix width and still refuses a partial set. The width is the same twelve legs on both speeds (the affected run does not derive its own count).

### H1 — measured, not assumed

- One leaf file changed (`packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanColumnSummary.ts`), on this 4-core shared box: `vitest list --changed` selected 92 test files but spent **254.7 s** transforming every test file's import graph before running anything, and it is blind to setup-file and disk-read edges. `turbo ls --affected` answered in **0.26 s** (8 packages). The package graph was taken; the selector computes its own closure in about 1.5 s and the test pins its agreement with turbo.
- Replayed over the newest **200** first-parent commits of `main` (each commit's own diff; the current tree supplies the always-on set): **63 (32%)** would run the full suite (57 of them because i18n or a package upstream of it was affected, 4 a `package.json`, 1 a root file, 1 a `vite.config.ts`); share of test files selected: **p25 41%, median 45%, p75 100%, mean 62%**. A docs-only change selects the always-on floor, 622 of 4,931 tracked test files.
- Sharding still pays on the affected speed: the floor alone is about a full shard's worth of today's files.

### Before (jobs API, newest 300 completed `CI` runs, 2026-10-09T13:14Z → 2026-10-12T08:42Z)

| event | runs | wall median / p90 | runner-min median / p90 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pull_request` | 137 | 17.3 / 18.0 min | 128.0 / 139.4 |
| `merge_group` | 78 | 17.5 / 18.0 min | 132.0 / 141.9 |
| `push` | 74 | 39.3 / 40.7 min | 151.3 / 165.2 |

Test shard **test step** median 13.0 min (PR) / 14.5 (queue); install 0.1 min. `Type Check` 9.3 (PR) / 10.6 (queue). `Spec Main Shape Gate` 12.8 / 13.3.

### After — projected here; the measured run of this PR is in the report comment on the card

- Full suite at twelve legs: about 8/12 of today's shard step. Affected median: about 45% of that.
- ⚠️ **The PR and queue wall is then bound by `Spec Main Shape Gate` (12.8–13.3 min, see H3) and `Type Check` (9.3–10.6 min), neither of which this card changes.** The card's acceptance line "a product-only PR's checks all conclude within 8 minutes" is therefore not reachable by items 1–4 alone; named as the follow-up below.
- This PR's own diff selects `mode=full` (it changes `lychee.toml`, a root config file), so its own `Test` run is the full suite at twelve legs.

## 2. Spec Main Shape Gate (`spec-main-shape-gate.yml`)

- **H3 refuted on its premise.** Step medians over 120 runs (2026-10-11T07:53Z → 2026-10-12T08:57Z): build **1.3 min**, pack **0.3 min**, forced type-check **10.6 / 11.1 min** of a 12.8 / 13.3 job. Caching the spec saves at most ~1.6 min per run; the forced compile is the cost, and it is uncached by design.
- `actions/cache` is branch-scoped: a pull request cannot read another pull request's cache, so a cache written by PR runs would hit only that PR's own re-runs. A pull request or queue build also runs its own branch's YAML, so what it uploads is not evidence about a spec.
- **What landed:** the hourly `schedule` run on `main` publishes the packed spec plus the sha it was packed at as the artifact `objectstack-spec-SHA` (one day); every other run looks it up by the sha it resolved, reuses it **only** if a `main` run of this repository built it, and otherwise builds. A failed lookup or download, or an artifact recording another sha, means build. `actions: read` is added; nothing writes through the token; no `actions/cache` (the turbo-cache prohibition pin stands).
- **Hit rate, modelled on real data** (objectstack `main` commit times vs this gate's 116 run starts, 101 objectstack commits in the window): hourly warm **22%** (expected saving ≈ 0.35 min/run); a 30-min warm 35%, 15-min 53%, 10-min 64%. Reusing any earlier run's artifact would reach 44% but was rejected on provenance.
- **The real lever, not taken here:** `inject` writes the sha **and the injection time** into the turbo-hashed marker, so even a sound turbo cache can never hit. A marker keyed by sha alone plus a cache of the compile is a ruling-level change.

## 3. Repo Gates (`repo-gates.yml`)

Folded (old check-run → step names `CHECK — STEP`): Control Byte Scan, Action Ref Convention, Pre-Install Import Graph Check, Shell Escape Residue Scan, Inert vi.mock Specifier Check, Internal Docs Link Check, Doc Fence Language Check, Doc Example Id Check, Doc Component Type Check, Skill Guide Path Check, Skill Eval Token Check, Docs Route Eager Closure Check, Skill Example Check, Doc Snippet Type Check, README Export Check. Deleted: `control-bytes.yml`, `action-ref-convention.yml`, `pre-install-import-graph.yml`, `shell-escape-residue.yml`, `vi-mock-specifiers.yml`, `docs-links.yml`, `doc-fence-languages.yml`, `doc-example-ids.yml`, `doc-component-types.yml`, `skills-paths.yml`, `skill-eval-tokens.yml`, `docs-route-eager-closure.yml`, `skill-examples.yml`, `doc-snippet-types.yml`, `readme-exports.yml`.

- Same commands, same events (`pull_request`, `push`, `merge_group`, `workflow_dispatch`), no path filter. One checkout, one setup. Every gate step runs `if: !cancelled()` (or on the install / build it needs), so one red never hides another.
- Install-free gates run **before** the install, so they stay in the pre-install import-graph population. The three type-surface gates share **one** build: `--filter='./packages/*'` in union with the two derived `--build-filter` closures; the derive steps now refuse an empty filter, and the build can never be unfiltered.
- **Not folded:** `governed-surface-guard.yml` (ruled), `changeset-presence.yml` (its `Changeset Declaration` is required), `spec-main-shape-gate.yml` (required; item 2), `changeset-guard.yml` (not on the card's list).
- `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` waits for `Repo Gates` instead of the fifteen names; its partition test, the `merge_group` floor map and each gate's pin test move to the new home (install-free absence pins became order pins). The pipeline guide documents the fifteen under one Repo Gates section.

### Required check-run names — byte-identical

Live read of the ruleset (`GET /rules/branches/main`), before this PR: `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Test`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. After: the same eight names, produced by the same workflows (`lint.yml`, `ci.yml` ×4, `changeset-presence.yml`, `spec-main-shape-gate.yml`, `governed-surface-guard.yml`). None of the fifteen folded names was required, so no ruleset edit is needed. `merge-queue-reporting.test.ts` re-derives every declared context to a `merge_group`-subscribed producer.

## 4. Lint

Unchanged (6.0 min median). It is not the critical path after items 1–3; `Spec Main Shape Gate`'s forced compile and `Type Check` are, and those are the named follow-ups.

## Verification (local, on `2fbe080c`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/ eslint-rules/` on `2fbe080c`: **192 files passed, 2 skipped; 5767 tests passed** (VERDICT command-exit 0). An earlier run on the first commit had two 15 s timeouts under box load (`check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-i18n-dead-keys`) that passed on re-run, unchanged.
- `pnpm type-check` 81/81 tasks; `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0; `pnpm lint` 47/47 tasks (0 errors); `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 43 changed `scripts/` files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Workflow-reading self-tests: `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `check-required-check-set`, `check-governed-queue-guard`, `check-bash32-floor`, `check-cross-repo-closer-outcome` — all exit 0.
- The fifteen folded gates run live on this tree: all exit 0 (the three type gates after building every package under `packages/`, as the job does).
- Ablation: deleting the `main`-only filter from the spec reuse lookup turns its pin red; restored from HEAD, blob hash verified.
- YAML parse of `ci.yml`, `spec-main-shape-gate.yml`, `repo-gates.yml` and every edited workflow. `actionlint`: NOT MEASURED, not installed here.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: no changeset owed (no published source changed).

## Acceptance notes

- AGENTS.md's test section still says `pnpm test` is what CI runs with `--shard=1/4`; it was already stale on the width, and a pull request's CI now runs the affected set. AGENTS.md is governed and untouched here.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test .github/workflows/repo-gates.yml` answers NOT GOVERNED: this repository's governed surfaces do not include `.github/workflows/**`. The PR stays a draft regardless, as a dispatched PR.
- The `submodules: true` checkout option is carried over unchanged; the tree declares no submodule.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:PR 与合并队列只跑受改动影响的测试(按包依赖图选取，外加读磁盘等图看不见的测试常驻);main 的每次合并与每小时定时任务跑全量测试和覆盖率。测试矩阵 8 → 12 路(#12208 第一个 PR,并入本 PR)。Spec 形状门禁按 objectstack 提交复用已构建的 spec。十五个单检查工作流并成一个 `Repo Gates` 作业，检查名保留为步骤名。

**为什么改**:您的原话「我觉得能让整个车队提速的方案就是好方案，main 很多天才会发一个版本，我只要确保发版本之前做好各种测试就可以。」—— 全量测试挪到 main,不删不减。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:快速集合漏掉的问题会在一小时内由 main 的全量运行变红(这是两速制的既定代价)。必需检查名逐字未变，无需改仓库设置。Spec 复用实测只省约 1.6 分钟中的命中部分(模型命中率 22%),门禁真正的耗时在强制类型检查;PR 墙钟此后受 Spec 门禁与 Type Check 约束(约 13 分钟),达不到卡上 8 分钟验收线。回滚:按倒序 revert 四个提交(第 2 个改的是第 1 个的同一批行),或整个 PR 一次 revert。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅并批准;落地由席位执行。若要更高的 Spec 复用命中率，可裁定把定时预热改为每 10–15 分钟一次。
